reasons.NO_ORDER_LINE: It names no line of the purchase order.
reasons.PRODUCT_DIFFERS: It is for a different product from the order line.
reasons.QTY_EXCEEDS_RECEIVED: It charges for more than was received.
reasons.PRICE_OUTSIDE_TOLERANCE: Its price is more than 1 percent away from the order's price.
reasons.LEVY_DIFFERS: A levy the supplier charged differs from the one worked out.

fields.orderHint: The order the supplier is invoicing.
fields.receiptHint: The posted receipt the goods came in on.
fields.invoiceNoHint: As printed on the supplier's invoice.
fields.dueDateHint: Leave empty for the server to set it.
fields.dueBefore: The due date cannot be before the invoice date.
fields.statedGross: Total printed on the invoice, GHS
fields.statedGrossHint: If given, the lines must add up to it exactly, or the server refuses the invoice.
fields.methodHint: Bank and mobile money pay the supplier's approved payout details.
fields.scheduledForHint: Optional: the day the payment is planned for.

invoices.title: Supplier invoices
invoices.emptyBody: A supplier's invoice is entered against its purchase order and the receipt the goods came in on.
invoices.error: The supplier invoices could not be loaded

enter.title: Enter a supplier invoice
enter.hint: Type what the supplier's invoice says, line by line. The server prices and totals it, and checks it against the order and what was received.
enter.receiptNone: This receipt has no lines from the order
enter.receiptError: The receipt could not be loaded
enter.linesHint: One line for each line of the order that came in. Leave a line off if the supplier did not charge it.
enter.noLines: Put at least one line on the invoice.
enter.qtyWrong: Enter a quantity, such as 18 or 18.5.

invoice.notFound: This supplier invoice was not found
invoice.error: The invoice could not be loaded

match.unmatched: Not checked against the order yet
match.unmatchedBody: Check it against order {{order}} and what was received before it can be approved for payment.
match.matched: Every line matches the order and what was received
match.notRequired: No match is needed: nothing on it was ordered
match.varianceApproved: Paid as invoiced: a difference in price or levy was approved
match.mismatch_one: 1 line disagrees with the order or what was received
match.mismatch_other: {{count}} lines disagree with the order or what was received
match.mismatchBody: It cannot be paid until it matches. Correct the invoice with the supplier, receive the rest of the goods, or, for a price or levy only, ask to pay it as invoiced.
match.priceOver: over the order's price on this line.
match.priceUnder: under the order's price on this line.

actions.match: Check against the order and receipt
actions.approveBody: The server checks it against the order and what was received once more. Once approved, it can be paid.
actions.variance: Ask to pay it as invoiced
actions.varianceTitle: Ask to pay it as invoiced?
actions.varianceBody: The price or a levy differs from the order. Say why it should be paid as the supplier invoiced it. A different person approves it.
actions.submitCreditBody: A different person approves it. Nothing is credited until then.
actions.cancelBody: Only an invoice entered in error is cancelled. Its number may be entered again.

payments.title: Supplier payments
payments.emptyBody: A payment is prepared against approved invoices, then approved by a different person.
payments.error: The supplier payments could not be loaded

prepare.title: Prepare a payment
prepare.hint: Choose the approved invoices it pays and how much on each. A different person approves the payment before it is paid.
prepare.noInvoices: Nothing is owed to this supplier on an approved invoice
prepare.noInvoicesBody: An invoice is approved for payment once it matches its order and what was received.
prepare.invoicesError: The invoices could not be loaded
prepare.noneChosen: Choose at least one invoice to pay.
prepare.amountWrong: Enter an amount above nothing and no more than is still owed.

payment.notFound: This supplier payment was not found
payment.error: The payment could not be loaded

paymentActions.submitBody: A different person must approve it: whoever prepares a supplier payment cannot approve it.
paymentActions.waitingBody: A different person from the one who prepared it approves it in the approvals inbox.
paymentActions.waitingYours: You prepared it, so someone else must approve it.
paymentActions.rejected: The approver rejected this payment. The invoices it was paying are free to pay again.
paymentActions.markPaidBody: Give the time it was paid and the bank or mobile money reference. The server numbers the payment and fixes its remittance advice.
paymentActions.notRecorded: The payment was not recorded as paid
paymentActions.paidAtWrong: Enter the time as hours and minutes, such as 14:30.
paymentActions.cancelBody: The invoices it was paying are free to pay again.

paymentOutcome.paid: The payment is recorded as paid
paymentOutcome.otherApprover: Someone other than you must approve it.

remittance.title: Remittance advice
remittance.lines: What it paid on each invoice
remittance.error: The remittance advice could not be loaded
remittance.denied: You cannot see the remittance advice

claim.error: The claim could not be loaded
claim.denied: You cannot see claims with suppliers
claim.title: Claim on receipt {{receipt}}
claim.settleIntro: Settle it by the invoice from {{supplier}} that left the rejected goods out, or turn it into a credit note against the invoice that charged them.
claim.settleDialog: Settle the claim by an invoice?
claim.settleBody: Choose the approved invoice of this order that did not charge for the goods turned away.
claim.credit: Turn it into a credit note
claim.creditDialog: Turn the claim into a credit note?
claim.creditBody: The credit note's lines and amounts are the claim's. It is sent for approval, and its approval settles the claim.
claim.notDrafted: The credit note was not drafted
claim.invoiceSettleHint: An approved invoice of this order that left the rejected goods out.
claim.invoiceCreditHint: The approved invoice that charged for the rejected goods.
claim.noInvoices: No approved invoice of this order yet
claim.creditNoHint: As printed on the supplier's credit note.
claim.creditDrafted: Credit note {{number}} is drafted from this claim
claim.whoSettles: The Accountant or the Owner settles a claim.

account.title: {{supplier}}'s account
account.error: The supplier could not be loaded
account.invoicesEmpty: Nothing is owed on an invoice

balance.title: Balance
balance.error: The balance could not be loaded
balance.denied: You cannot see this supplier's balance
balance.waits: The balance waits for the server
balance.waitsBody: The server does not give a supplier's balance yet. Each invoice, claim and payment below shows its own amounts.
